mapper.sql: id, username, remind_date, title, content, done_yn, create_dt, modify_dt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reminders (id, username, remind_date, title, content, done_yn, create_dt, modify_dt) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{remindDate}, #{title}, #{content}, #{doneYn}, #{createDt}, #{modifyDt})
mapper.update: UPDATE reminders SET remind_date = #{remindDate}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, done_yn = #{doneYn}, modify_dt = #{modifyDt} WHERE id = #{id} AND username = #{username}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM reminders WHERE id = #{id} AND username = #{username}
